en-US.description: Aggregate and browse AI coding agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.) in one place. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.
en-US.longDescription: Codeg (Code Generation) is an enterprise-grade multi-agent coding workspace. It unifies local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw, Cline, etc.) in a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container — enabling remote development from any browser — with conversation aggregation, parallel git worktree development, MCP/Skills management, chat channel interactions (Telegram, Lark, iLink, etc.), and integrated Git/file/terminal workflows.
en-US.name: codeg
en-US.releaseNotes:
This release reduces memory growth during extended use, fixes missing collaboration tools in forked Codex conversations, restores skill selection for custom agents, and updates several agents.
Improved
- Claude Code is updated to 2.1.322 with adapter 0.106.0.
- Updated OpenCode to 2.2.7, Kimi Code to 2.5.3, Hermes Agent to 0.23.1 and the ZCode bridge to 0.83.3.
Fixed
- Reduced memory buildup during repeated scrolling, view changes and streaming code generation, improving memory usage during extended sessions. (#1114, #1115, #1117 by @kogekiplay)
- Custom agents with a configured skill directory or shared skill store now list their skills in the / menu, in both chat and automation editors. (#1121 by @ana52070)
- Forked Codex conversations retain their enabled MCP tools, allowing you to continue delegating work to sub-agents and retrieving their results. (#1105)
- Reopening a conversation no longer adds duplicate context compaction cards after the existing history.
- OpenCode commands that time out or are terminated no longer incorrectly appear as successful.
- OpenCode file previews correctly display reads beyond the end of a file, while reads counted from the end no longer show a misleading line range.
- Reopening older ZCode conversations correctly restores their saved titles.
Thanks to @kogekiplay (#1114, #1115, #1117) and @ana52070 (#1121) for their contributions, and to @lxpsxx (#1105) for the report.

zh-CN.description: 在一个地方聚合并浏览 AI 编程代理会话（如 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等）。支持桌面应用、自建服务器或 Docker 部署。
zh-CN.longDescription: Codeg（Code Generation，代码生成）是一款企业级多代理编码工作区。它将本地 AI 编程代理（包括 Claude Code、Codex CLI、OpenCode、Gemini CLI、OpenClaw、Cline 等）统一集成于桌面应用、独立服务器或 Docker 容器中，支持通过任意浏览器进行远程开发；具备对话聚合、并行 Git 工作树开发、MCP/技能管理、聊天频道交互（Telegram、飞书、iLink 等），以及集成的 Git/文件/终端工作流。
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
这一版改善长时间使用时的内存占用，修复 Codex 分叉会话后协作工具丢失、自定义智能体无法选择技能等问题，并更新多个智能体。
改进
- Claude Code 更新至 2.1.322，适配器更新至 0.106.0。
- OpenCode 更新至 2.2.7，Kimi Code 更新至 2.5.3，Hermes Agent 更新至 0.23.1，ZCode 桥接更新至 0.83.3。
修复
- 减少反复滚动、切换视图和持续生成代码时的内存累积，改善长时间使用时的内存占用。（#1114、#1115、#1117 by @kogekiplay）
- 配置了技能目录或共享技能库的自定义智能体，可以在 / 菜单中选择技能，聊天输入框和自动化编辑器均可使用。（#1121 by @ana52070）
- Codex 分叉会话后会保留已启用的 MCP 工具，可以继续委派子智能体并获取执行结果。（#1105）
- 重新打开会话时，已有的上下文压缩卡片不会再重复出现在历史记录末尾。
- OpenCode 中超时或被终止的命令，不再被误标为执行成功。
- OpenCode 读取位置超出文件末尾时，返回内容仍能正确预览，从文件末尾倒数读取时也不会再显示错误的行号范围。
- 重新打开较早的 ZCode 会话时，能正确恢复已保存的会话标题。
感谢 @kogekiplay（#1114、#1115、#1117）和 @ana52070（#1121）的贡献，以及 @lxpsxx（#1105）的反馈。
